2607.14616.title: SportD: Can VLMs Physically Strategize?
2607.14616.paper_summary: Vision--language models have become increasingly capable of interpreting visual scenes, but it remains unclear whether they can use information to make strategically effective decisions. We investigate this question in soccer, where models observe the seconds preceding an on-ball decision and must choose whether to shoot or pass to a specific teammate. Unlike conventional visual-understanding tasks, soccer enables decisions to be evaluated quantitatively by estimating the value of every available action. We introduce SportD, a benchmark comprising 478 on-ball decisions from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Each model choice is evaluated against a possession-value model that estimates the action that most increases the attacking team's probability of scoring, allowing us to measure both optimal-action accuracy and the value forfeited by suboptimal decisions. Across three frontier VLMs, the best selects the highest-valued action on 31.4% of events, compared with 38.9% for the professional players, and all models incur significantly greater regret. Further analysis reveals a systematic preference for lower-variance and lower-reward actions: VLMs shoot less often and select substantially less progressive passes than either the optimal policy or the real players. The models also reproduce the player's specific action above chance even when that action is suboptimal, suggesting partial imitation of familiar play patterns rather than consistent evaluation of counterfactual alternatives. SportD provides a value-grounded testbed for measuring physical strategic reasoning in VLMs.
2607.14616.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型在解釋視覺場景方面變得越來越有能力，但尚不清楚它們是否能利用信息做出戰略上有效的決策。<lb/>我們在足球中探討這個問題，模型觀察在球上決策前的幾秒鐘，並必須選擇是射門還是傳球給特定隊友。<lb/>與傳統的視覺理解任務不同，足球使得通過估計每個可用行動的價值來定量評估決策成為可能。<lb/>我們介紹了SportD，一個基準，包含2022年國際足總世界杯的478個球上決策。<lb/>每個模型的選擇都與一個估計最能提高進攻隊伍得分概率的行動的持球價值模型進行評估，這使我們能夠測量最佳行動的準確性以及由次優決策所放棄的價值。<lb/>在三個前沿的VLM中，最佳模型在31.4%的事件中選擇了最高價值的行動，而專業球員則為38.9%，所有模型都產生了顯著更大的遺憾。<lb/>進一步分析顯示出對較低方差和較低回報行動的系統性偏好：VLM的射門頻率較低，選擇的進攻傳球明顯低於最佳策略或真實球員。<lb/>即使該行動是次優的，模型也能重現球員的特定行動，超過隨機機率，這表明對熟悉的比賽模式的部分模仿，而不是對反事實替代方案的一致評估。<lb/>SportD提供了一個基於價值的測試平台，用於測量VLM中的物理戰略推理。
